messages:
Alex M: Heads up — Community HackWeek content sprint the week of Apr 20. Goal: 8 tutorials, 2 reference apps, 1 benchmark post, 1 webinar. Staggered launch across 2 weeks. Need owners for tutorials, refapps, webinar host, and inbound lead routing.
Mira K: Happy to own tutorial coordination + templates. Can we scope 8 -> 4 quickstarts + 4 deep dives?
Sam T: I can take one refapp and the benchmark narrative (latency/cost story). Will need infra for benchmarks — can we get dedicated test tokens?
Jo P: I'll run the webinar logistics. Prefer 45m: 20 demo + 20 Q&A + 5 wrap. Live coding on refapp. Need volunteers for demo pair.
Nina R: DevRel can host hacknight and collect contributor guides. Also can run community office hours post-launch.
Alex M: Thanks — assign: Mira tutorials, Sam benchmark+refapp A, Jo webinar, Nina community ops, Alex will own hero launch post + GTM comms.
Sam T: For benchmark narrative: focus on cost-per-100k tokens and throughput under tail latency. Will prepare runbook and scripts. Any constraints on using prod models? @devops-bot
devops-bot: @Sam T — request received. Please file infra request here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/issue/INFR-482
Mira K: Templates — I've drafted a skeleton doc: https://notion.so/redwood/hackweek-content-template. Includes sections: TL;DR, code snippets, run instructions, expected results, TLDR banner. Feedback?
Jo P: For webinar landing page: gate with email + company size (optional). Routing: HubSpot list -> SDR queue if company size > 100 or role contains 'engineer'. Otherwise nurture drip. Thoughts?
Nina R: Agree. Add UTM params and source=hackweek. Also add a short survey after webinar to tag intent. We'll capture with hidden fields.
Alex M: Sam please add example UTM string to runbook. Mira add CTA blocks in templates. Jo set up HubSpot form and SDR mapping. Deadline: asset freeze in 9 business days.
Sam T: UTM example in runbook:
```
?utm_source=hackweek&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=hw-sprint-2026&utm_content=refapp-demo
```
Mira K: I'll prep 4 short Twitter threads + 2 long-form blog drafts and send copy by EOD Wed.
Jo P: Scheduling note: prefer Tue 18th 10am PT for the webinar. Who's available to demo?
Alex M: @Sam T + @Mira K can demo refapp. I'll moderate. Quick sync Friday 9am PT to finalize assets.
Nina R: :thumbsup: I'll circulate hacknight invite and link community channels.
Alex M: Perfect. If any blockers reply here. :rocket:
